intent.proves: Every flow sits in a flow folder, so the folder list shows it.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(EmailMarketingFlowId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(EmailMarketingFlowName, N'') FROM EmailMarketingFlow WHERE ISNULL(EmailMarketingFlowFolderId, 0) = 0
